content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Usdt payment

USDT payment gateways provide a blockchain-based solution for digital creators to receive payments in cryptocurrency. This technology is particularly relevant for creators in countries where traditional payment platforms are inaccessible or charge exorbitant fees. By utilizing USDT, which is a stablecoin pegged to the US dollar, creators can maintain price stability while enjoying the benefits of cryptocurrency transactions. This approach not only lowers transaction costs—NOWPayments charges just 0.5% compared to Gumroad's 10%—but also enhances financial sovereignty for creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a USDT payment gateway involves multiple components working in harmony. At the core, you have a smart contract that facilitates the transaction, ensuring that payments are securely processed on-chain. After a customer initiates a payment, the gateway verifies the transaction and triggers an automatic delivery of the digital product. This process can be efficiently managed through platforms like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring that creators have full control over their sales without reliance on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who are blocked from using mainstream payment processors due to regional restrictions. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or digital templates, this solution empowers you to monetize your offerings without incurring high fees. The economic impact is significant; for instance, with 100 sales per month of a $97 product, a creator retains $921 more by choosing NOWPayments over traditional platforms. This framework enables creators to establish a sustainable income stream.
NOWPayments offers a low 0.5% fee, maximizing your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of a USDT payment gateway include the payment processor, the smart contract for transaction verification, and a delivery mechanism for digital products. Tools like Supabase can handle order storage, while services like Google Drive can be used for file delivery. Together, these elements create a cohesive ecosystem that ensures products are delivered instantly upon payment confirmation. The combination of these tools allows for a robust, decentralized commerce stack that supports a wide range of digital products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with a USDT payment gateway, first, select a suitable hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement a backend logic layer using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Once the infrastructure is in place, configure your payment processor, such as NOWPayments, to handle USDT transactions. Finally, ensure that your digital products are stored in a reliable location like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless delivery. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
You can deliver products instantly with automated systems.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital products without the constraints of conventional payment platforms, explore options such as the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes everything you need to build your sovereign commerce stack and can be found at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell an ebook by using a USDT payment gateway like NOWPayments, which enables you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly. This reduces fees and allows for instant delivery of your product.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by implementing a USDT payment gateway. This allows you to manage your sales independently and keep more of your earnings.
What infrastructure do I need to set up a payment gateway?
To set up a payment gateway, you will need a hosting solution, a backend logic tool, a payment processor like NOWPayments, and a reliable storage solution for your files.
How does NOWPayments compare with traditional payment processors?
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, which is significantly lower than the 10% fee from platforms like Gumroad. This allows you to retain more of your revenue.
